title: Chapter 102 — The Frontier: Automation, Agents, and Staying Current
intro: Automation judgment, the agent horizon, and staying current.

sections.title: What Is Coming — and What to Watch
sections.content:
AI is evolving rapidly. Automated follow-up sequences, intelligent lead scoring, predictive inventory, and AI agents that handle routine customer interactions are all emerging.

The principle stays the same: AI handles the process. Humans handle the relationship. As automation grows, the human skills — empathy, trust-building, creative problem-solving — become more valuable, not less.

Stay current with AI tools. Experiment. Learn. But never lose sight of the fact that people buy from people they trust.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating AI readiness, ask:

Is the salesperson staying current with new AI tools — or falling behind?
Do they experiment with new capabilities — or resist change?
Do they maintain the human relationship as the center of their process — regardless of what AI can do?
